content: प्रोक्षणम् .²1 Sprinkling, sprinkling with water; अद्भिस्तु प्रोक्षणं शौचं बहूनां धान्यवाससाम् <ls>Ms. 5. 118</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 184</ls>. .²2 Consecration by sprinkling. .²3 Immolation (of animals) at a sacrifice. .²4 A text to be repeated at an animal-sacrifice; .²5 A vessel for holy water. .{@-णी, प्रोक्षणिः@} {%f.%} Water used for sprinkling or consecrating, holy water; याभिरद्भिर्हविषः पुरोडाशानां च प्रोक्षणं कृतं ताः प्रोक्षण्यः <ls>Karka.</ls> (Used in <ab>pl.</ab>, and sometimes used to denote ‘the vessel containing holy water’, in which sense the word generally used is ग्रोक्षणीपात्र).
